whenToUse: Key buttons that are easy to miss at first, such as new note or share.
Buttons that moved in an update.
Once per screen, for one thing only.
whenNotToUse: Explaining several buttons in turn (use a product tour).
The button name alone is clear enough.
You'd show it again on every visit.

accessibility: The bubble is role=dialog, named by its text.
On open, focus goes to the OK button, and Esc closes it.
The dimmed area is decorative, so it's aria-hidden, and the highlighted button can still be pressed.
Keep the bubble's text to one short sentence.
